translation.name: Kitap molinas men ringkat na alaata'ala: perjanjian baru

content: Kurbaan men daa kana'

Ukum Torat tongko' simpaatukanna barakaat men bo taka iya'a, taasi'po men tuutuu'na. Mbali' tia kurbaan men koikoimo men sinampang kurbaankonon sanda' taun, Ukum Torat sian sida mompopokalepu i raaya'a men taka bakitumpu.
Kalu se' mian men bakitumpu iya'a tuutuu' noloe'mo a dosana, raaya'a sianmo munsurikon dosaon, ka' munsurikon sianmo mosoo momokela kurbaan.
Kasee men tuutuu'na kurbaan men nikurbaankon sanda' taun iya'a tongko' mompopo'inau'kon mian na dosana i raaya'a,
gause rara'na sapi' moro'one tia rara'na bembe' moro'one sian momoko manganui dosa.
Mbali' na tempo i Kristus taka na tano' balaki', Ia norobu na Alaata'ala, tae-Na:

content.text: kasee i Kuu ninsidakonmo i Yaku' montombonoi waka.
Kuu sian mingkira'kon kurbaan men tunuon kabai kurbaan men bo pontololoki dosa.
Yaku' taka bo mingilimang men kikira'-Muu,
koi men nitulismo na lulunanna kitap men nuntundunkon wakang-Ku.’ ”

content: Tumbena i Kristus norobu tae-Na, “Kuu sian mingkira'kon kurbaan ka' soor. Kuu sian mingkira'kon kurbaan ayop men tunuon tia kurbaan bo pontololoki dosa.” Kristus norobu koiya'a, maupo uga' giigii' kurbaan iya'a niwawaumo sintutu' koi na ukum Torat.
Noko daa iya'a Kristus norobu tae-Na: “Alaata'ala! Ni'imo i Yaku'. Yaku' taka bo mingilimang men kikira'-Muu.” Mbaka' Alaata'ala nansapui toon men olukon iya'a, ka' nombolosi tia toon men korua'na.
Yesus Kristus daamo ningilimang upa men kikira'na Alaata'ala ka' nongorookonmo waka-Na bookoi kurbaan see tongko' pensan pataka sidutu. Gause kurbaan iya'a, mbaka' dosanta giigii' noloe'mo.
Sanda' imam kumekerer mansalankon limangna sanda' ilio ka' sinampang momokela kurbaanna men koikoimo. Kasee kurbaan iya'a sian sida manganui dosa.
Kasee i Kristus nomokela tongko' sa'angu' kurbaan bo pontololoki dosa. Noko daa nomokela kurbaan iya'a, Kristus no'umoruangmo pataka manau' na paraas uananna Alaata'ala.
Ka' koini'i Kristus tongko' mempeperai tempona Alaata'ala mompoporungku' giigii' mian men mangka'idek i Kristus sida malolo' ni Ko'ona.
Kristus tongko' pensan nongorookon waka-Na bookoi kurbaan ka' i Ia nompopokana' pataka manau' mian men popokalepuion.
Men koiya'a Alus Molinas uga' nompotuutuu' na ko'onta'.
Ia norobu tae-Na,

content.text: “Koi kani'imari a toon men bo toonkonon-Ku na ko'ona i raaya'a ni'imarian:
Yaku' bo monsoopkon ukum-Ku na noana i raaya'a,
ka' muntulis na noana i raaya'a!”

content: Alaata'ala uga' norobu tae-Na,

content.text: “Yaku' sianmo minginau' dosana ka' idekna i raaya'a”.

content: Kalu se' giigii' iya'a ampunionmo, mbaka' mosoomo momokela kurbaan bo pontololoki dosa.
Maimo kita taka na Alaata'ala.
Utu-utus! Gause kolapusan ni Yesus iya'a mbaka' i kita koini'i momoko miminsoopi Lokis Molinas Tuu'.
Yesus noko pantatasmo sa'angu' salan men u'uru bo ko'onta'. Salan iya'a lumiu na toik pongola' ka' mangawawa i kita na tutuo' men pore. Salan iya'a ia tatas i Yesus tia waka-Na.
Kita koini'i montombonoi sa'angu' Imam Moola' Tuu' bo pantanaasi Laiganna Alaata'ala.
Mbaka' maimo kita taka na Alaata'ala tia noa men maloos ka' imaan men moonggor, ka' noa men tuutuu' parasaya gause niloe'imo na upa men ba'idek, ka' wakanta nitogisimo tia weer molino.
Kita tio sinampang mompotuutuu' men kita ooskonmo, gause Ia men nontoonkon mase malolo'.
Ka' mai kita poo'imamat kada' molingu'kon simbaya'ta ka' mingilimang men pore.

Alia i kita kobude'an poorimpungi bakitumpu koi men malia' wawauonna toropii mian. Kasee mai kita poo'ururanii tontuko tuu' na tempo koini'i, gause kuu inti'imo se' ilio kotakaanna Tumpu kaekae' karani'.
Gause kalu i kita sawauwau dosa, kasee i kita noko pinginti'imo pisiso' men kana', mbaka' sianmo isian kurbaan men bo pontololoki dosanta.
Men daa isian na ko'onta' somo mempeperai pungukumian men koriri' ka' apu men lumeleaambang muntunu giigii' mian men mangka'idek Alaata'ala.
Kalu rua' kabai tolu' mian mompotuutuu' se' isian mian men mongkosiankon ukum men ia tadulkon i Musa, mbaka' mian iya'a tio ukumon pate men sianta lino-linoan.

Upa mune' kalu rawatna ukuman men rookonon na mian men sian mangangga'i Anakna Alaata'ala, men munsurikon sianta angga'na a rara'na toonna Alaata'ala men nongoloe'i dosana! Ia sian mangangga'i Alus Molinas men pu'una kaporean.
Kita minginti'i i Ia men norobu taena,

content.text: “Yaku' a pangawalos! Yaku' bo mangawalos sala'na mian!”

content: Ka' men norobu taena,
Koriri' tuu' kalu Alaata'ala men tumuo' mansangkumi ka' mungukum i kita.
Inau' a tutuo'muu men mbaripian. Na tempo iya'a, sarataa ruarna Alaata'ala nunguruari i kuu, kuu nongololongi solon-solong men balaki', kasee i kuu nomoko bakitaan.
Mbaripian i kuu ni'iroki ka' niwawaukon men sian pore na aropna mian biai'. Isian uga' i kuu men tonsoop nangkaba' i raaya'a men niwawaukon koiya'a.

Ka' i kuu tonsoop nunsurikon repaanna mian men nitarungku. Na tempo kupangmuu ni'omuru, kuu nangalabot iya'a tia noa pore, gause i kuu ninginti'i se' i kuu dauga' montombonoi upa-upa men pore tuu' ka' men mantaan pataka manau'.
Mbaka' alia babata. Kalu i kuu sinampang parasaya, mbaka' isian dale' men balaki' bo ko'omuu!
Kuu tio moko pera kada' moko daa i kuu mingilimang pingkira'na Alaata'ala, kuu mandapot upa men Ia toonkon iya'a.
Gause na Alkitaap isian nitulis,

content.text: “Sianmo paraa manau', Ia men bo taka iya'a, daa takamo.
Mian men tumuo' mase mian men popokana'on-Ku gause parasaya na Ingku'.
Kasee kalu i ia mongkokundai i Yaku',

content: Kasee i kita taasi'po mian men mongkokundai i Ia ka' silaka'. Kita mase mian men parasaya na Alaata'ala ka' mantausi tutuo' men pore.
